admission_prerequisites: The paired timestep control has normal complete exit and passes its fixed numerical gates; its original leases are released.

All8 fixed500ps preparation branches complete normally and have a frozen whole-cohort scalar/structure assessment. Every unchanged scalar screen passes, and independent review finds no unresolved preparation issue; pointwise RDF confidence intervals crossing zero do not prove equivalence.
A new production-only runner/coordinator and a new general-lag analyzer are implemented, tested and independently reviewed. The old analyze_native.py hardcoded4ps/2ps analysis is not silently reused.
Freeze source/input/model/RNG/phase, the exact8new endpoints, this study and every analysis rule before the first new NVE step.
Verify all old/control/preparation exclusion leases are free and retain one-writer/prefix/failure protection.
Root separately adopts actual available CPU/memory/storage and the finite resource envelope.

estimators.D_MSD: Unweighted OLS MSD slope over the fixed lag interval, divided by6; OLS fit residuals are not used as independent-sample uncertainty.
estimators.D_VACF: One-third trapezoidal VACF integral from0 to the fixed cutoff; no fitted tail or assumed zero remainder.
estimators.per_segment_VACF: Sum_i,n v_i(n) dot v_i(n+k) / [216*(N-k)], with no per-record mean subtraction.

momentum_RNG_phase.final_segment: Stop without an extra draw after segment19.
momentum_RNG_phase.first_draw: At absolute step2000000 skip the pending preparation refresh and perform the one NVE COM-projected draw.
momentum_RNG_phase.fresh_draws: Exactly one saved-RNG Maxwell draw at298K with total physical COM removal before each of20segments; no reseeding.
momentum_RNG_phase.next_segment: Keep positions, draw new COM-projected momenta exactly once from the continued same RNG.
momentum_RNG_phase.restart: Persist active_segment, local/global step, pending-draw flag and RNG; exact raw q/v with bounded CPU force-cache conversion; resume without duplicate draws.
momentum_RNG_phase.source_used_for_state_conversion_and_Max: Frozen native_reference.py functions; the new orchestration must be independently tested before adoption.
momentum_RNG_phase.within_segment: Thermostat disabled; unchanged frozen velocity-Verlet/PME force map.

also_retain: Temperature with the original COM degree-of-freedom convention
Full native checkpoint and redundant raw-state contract every1ps
observables.positions: Unwrapped mass-weighted molecular COM coordinates from the frozen physical OHH observable; do not re-center saved displacements or minimum-image the accumulated displacement.
observables.velocities: Coincident canonical molecular COM velocities; preserve the saved three-dimensional dot-product convention.

proposed_new_finite_lag_screens.failure_or_insufficient_precision: Retain all data and report unresolved/failed. No dropping seeds/segments, alternative-window search, larger budget, fitted-tail switch or target-driven stop.
proposed_new_finite_lag_screens.interpretation: A new separately preregistered finite-lag consistency/precision screen. The old short-window gate stays failed; passing these new screens is not proof of the infinite-time limit or an automatic paper-agreement certificate.
required_paired_contrasts: Late10minus early10segment chain means for each primary estimator

relationship_to_old_experiment: A new prospective finite-time-regime study on new data after a separately assessed500ps preparation. It never changes the old0.5-1ps criterion or reclassifies the original failed cohort.
relationship_to_v2_post_gate_suggestion: The byte-frozen v2 document still governs only the proposed400ps preparation. Its unadopted25x4ps future-production suggestion is not adopted here; this separate20x20ps design requires its own implementation, review and root decision.
remaining_scientific_limits: The fixed216-molecule box and unchanged electrostatics/model identity are retained; no finite-size correction is selected to improve reference proximity.
The existing force-field source/Table-I precision and CPU rounding qualifications remain; no claim of exact author-implementation identity is added.
Longer preparation and longer correlation lags answer distinct questions. Neither guarantees equilibrium, infinite-time convergence, paper agreement or a quantum result.
The earlier dense5fs cadence control is a separate limited numerical check, not a validation of all new liquid trajectories.
required_new_method_tests: Reference canonical q/p map and continuous-versus-split restart at a preparation-end/first-NVE-draw boundary and an NVE-segment boundary.
CPU raw-state/force-cache bounds and failed/corrupt restore rejection, without loosening the frozen contract.
Synthetic nonuniform/finite-time-origin VACF/MSD normalization and analytical stationary-identity cases; correlated chain fixtures for whole-cohort/paired uncertainty.
Full8x20segment membership, unwrapped-displacement and source/model/input tamper guards; metadata-only resource/lease/drain tests.
A bounded excluded actual short Reference/CPU phase probe, without using production D to alter the design.
scope: Classical P1 q-TIP4P/F H2O,216molecules, unchanged finite box/model/0.25fs OpenMM CPU external reference. No quantum, IR, GPU or PyRPMD-production validation claim.

start_selection.selection: The exact final committed500ps state of each fixed preparation branch, before any terminal preparation or NVE momentum draw. No endpoint search.
start_selection.source_binding_before_adoption: Record every endpoint whole-file/q/p/raw-engine/RNG/model/source/environment identity only after all8 preparation branches and their coordinator finish normally.

statistics.CI95: mean +/- t_(0.975,7)*SE; nominal small-n inference conditional on the fixed histories.
statistics.independent_unit: Eight complete chain means, each averaging all20segments equally; never160independent segments, molecules or overlapping origins.
statistics.interval_qualification: Marginal/pointwise intervals, no simultaneous confidence band or guaranteed liquid-tail coverage.
statistics.old_and_new_cohorts: Shared ancestry; do not treat old and new outcomes as16independent chains or pool their segments.
statistics.paired_comparisons: Compute each difference within chain first, then use its8differences and df7; preserve estimator/cutoff/window covariance.
statistics.production_time_diagnostic: Predeclare segments0-9 versus10-19 within every chain; retain all20in every primary mean.
statistics.standard_error: Sample SD of8chain means divided bysqrt(8).
